## Start with context

Ask why the image appears beside the surrounding text. Describe the information or action it contributes.

The simulated editorial dataset below lets you compare the quantitative
relationship communicated by a Chart with its exact data table. The values are
illustrative, not evidence about a real publishing team.

<Chart
  title="Average published and reviewed lessons per editor"
  description="Average published and reviewed lesson counts per editor are compared for June and July."
  howToRead="Read months from left to right and compare each pair of bars."
  takeaway="Reviews kept pace in June but lagged behind publishing in July."
  xAxis={{ label: "Month", unit: "month" }}

  ]}
